title: BrandKit Assets Don't Appear in the Entry Asset Picker
alternate_search_terms: BrandKit assets not showing in asset picker
BrandKit library assets missing from entry
assets visible in BrandKit but not in picker

extracted_facts.problem: BrandKit assets were not showing up in the entry asset picker despite being visible in the BrandKit library itself.
extracted_facts.root_cause: The assets were uploaded under a BrandKit workspace not yet linked to the stack being edited.
resolution_steps: Link the correct BrandKit workspace to the stack under Settings.
